  _previously: six or seven years old (v2)_  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is distinguished by her neat and proper appearance, wearing a nicely starched white dress accented with a black sash. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, a "prunes and prisms" mouth, and long, sleek curls that consistently stay in order.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a lovely, quiet, and exceptionally well-behaved child who conducts herself with notable primness and composure. Highly neat, industrious, and faithful, she approaches her small tasks carefully, systematically, and dispassionately, never needing to be instructed twice or forgetting her duties. She is observant and demure, speaking only when spoken to and acting as a model child who rarely causes any trouble. Learned and obedient, she recites meekly and maintains a monotonous, good-natured demeanor. Even at eight years old, it takes a great deal to disturb her placid nature.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +8 more_

## History

Dora Keith was brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) along with her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), though she soon suffered from his antics when he caused her to fall into a pigpen and later locked her in a toolhouse. Following the death of her uncle [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), who left money in trust for the twins, her permanent home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) was secured. At school, she was once frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's ghost stories, and she was later coerced by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to fish and play with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Despite her brother's influence, she remained a steady presence in the household, regularly spending quiet time with her family and greeting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon her returns from college.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), +26 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's twin brother. Dora frequently ends up as the victim of Davy's mischievous pranks, such as when he causes her to fall into a pigpen or hides her away in a toolhouse, causing the household to fear for her safety.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +19 more_

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +11 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dora.md)

Dora resides with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and attends the school where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) teaches. Their relationship is warm, with Dora affectionately welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon her returns home, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps comfort and care for her, such as when Dora is frightened by ghost stories at school.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P9](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0009), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcoming her affectionately on her return home (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
